reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Direct GSDMD N-terminal membrane action tested by purified protein/defined lipid reconstitution, orthogonal physical permeability and qualified mutant cellular rescue; conditional indirect-effector branch.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original Methods, supplements or validated protein/membrane/cell protocols to select and verify transferable conditions. Naming unknown settings and proposing local validation does not meet this separate lookup requirement.

checks.quote: Removing a candidate cellular effector does not abolish
checks.reason: Direct biochemical membrane activity does not imply that deleting a cellular factor cannot abolish cellular permeability: an essential permissive recruitment/organization factor may be needed. The later hybrid caveat does not repair this categorical prediction.

checks.quote: These must be measured and reported prospectively rather than inferred.
checks.reason: Unknown buffer, temperature, timing, lipid ratios and cell conditions are listed without operational calibration-to-choice procedures.

No membrane-free tracer/protein optical-interference control, independent reporter recovery gate or quantitative calibration acceptance/failure procedure. Orthogonal electrical assays help but do not calibrate the fluorescence measurement.
Independent preparation routes are useful but no independent culture/batch replication and meaningful-effect precision/power plan justifies confirmation sample size.
No prospective randomized/balanced sample processing, allocation concealment or blinded recording/analysis, or justified equivalent.
No prespecified technical exclusion, attrition and stopping policy preserving biological nonresponses.
No selected primary contrast/time window, statistical model, uncertainty construction or multiplicity method.

checks.quote: mixed membranes spanning a rational range of charge and order
checks.reason: The limited qualitative lipid classes are named, but composition/protein concentration exploration has no bounded quantitative range or objective range-derivation and locking rule.
A failed reconstitution triggers alternatives but no revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: GSDMD-deficient cells rescued with cleavage-resistant full-length GSDMD
checks.reason: Wild-type/cleavage-resistant rescue tests pathway activation, not whether the purified membrane-disrupting property causes the cellular phenotype. No qualified membrane-binding/assembly separation-of-function cellular bridge tests that causal link.
No complete construct/protein/lipid/culture-to-raw-acquisition manifest, analysis versions/settings and exclusion provenance.

historical_match_reason: Question and readout components match: "directly permeabilize a chemically defined lipid bilayer" and flotation/leakage/conductance/structural imaging plus wild-type cellular rescue. Mechanism, intervention and predicted-outcome components do not fully match the conjunctive target: the only proposed GSDMD mutant is cleavage-resistant, not a qualified binding/assembly separation-of-function perturbation. There is no prediction linking selective loss of purified physical membrane activity to loss of cellular rescue under preserved activation/folding. Match [true,false,false,true,false] agrees with round one; non-hit is not a claim that the overall research question is unvaluable.
